verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs show mechanisms aimed at reducing noise — custom rules for review behavior (graphite-docs-5) and comment exclusions to suppress unwanted comments (graphite-docs-20) — plus general 'catching bugs' claims (graphite-docs-18/19). However there is no explicit mention of severity labeling or comment deduplication, and no independent/hands-on evidence quantifying false-positive rates; one community comment expresses skepticism about the AI review UI's long-term value (graphite-comm-10), though this is not a concrete failure report. missing for 10: explicit severity-label feature, deduplication mechanism, independent benchmark or hands-on report on false-positive rate.
